_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Matched to a model name by longest 'match' prefix. Costs recompute on every query (no re-ingest needed). BASIS: empirically fit to Claude Code's own /usage panel on Opus 4.x = 0.40x Anthropic public list price (verified 2026-07-24: single-turn $0.06 vs list $0.15; multi-turn session $0.17 vs /usage $0.18). This reflects effective/subscription pricing, NOT the public list rate. To see raw list-price estimates instead, multiply every number below by 2.5. Sonnet/Haiku are scaled by the same 0.40x factor off their list rates (not independently verified — adjust if you confirm their real rates).
